newsitem.title: TURKEY: Tanker on fire in Turkish docks after explosion.
newsitem.headline: Tanker on fire in Turkish docks after explosion.

text.p: Turkey's biggest oil tanker was engulfed in flames in an Istanbul dockyard late on Thursday after an explosion, officials at the dockyard said.
"The fire and the explosions are still continuing on the tanker. It is called TPAO," said an official at Istanbul's Tuzla dockyard. The ship was in the yard for repairs, he said.

"We have two injured. The police are taking all the necessary measures to ensure the safety of any other people there," Tuzla district governor Erdogan Gurbuz told private Kanal D television. "Everything is covered in smoke here."
He said ambulances and nearby hospitals were on stand-by to receive any casualties.
Officials said the TPAO was Turkey's biggest oil tanker.
Anatolian, which had earlier identified the tanker as Nassia, said it was 307 metres long and 86,595 gross tonnes.
Gurbuz said explosions in the gas depot were responsible for the fire, but the reason for the blasts was unclear.
Anatolian said the fire had spread to some other ships and Turkish television said the damage was extensive.
